class.name: VECSComponent
class.brief_description:
A field-level accessor for one component instance attached to an entity.
一个组件实例（挂在某个实体上）的字段级访问器。
class.description:
[b]VECSComponent[/b] is a transient accessor obtained from [method VECSEntity.get_component]. Reads and writes go straight to the entity's archetype column, so every [method set_field] is reflected immediately and marks the row as changed (which feeds [code].changed()[/code] queries).
The accessor stays valid for the lifetime of the entity; after a structural change the underlying storage may move, so re-fetch the accessor if you keep it across such changes.
[b]VECSComponent[/b] 是通过 [method VECSEntity.get_component] 获取的临时访问器。读写直接落到实体的 archetype 列，因此每次 [method set_field] 都立即生效并标记该行已变更（供 [code].changed()[/code] 查询使用）。
访问器在实体存活期间有效；结构性变更后底层存储可能移动，因此若跨此类变更持有访问器，请重新获取。

method.name: get_field
method.description:
Returns the value of the field [param name]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the field does not exist on this component type.
返回字段 [param name] 的值。若该组件类型上没有此字段则返回 [code]null[/code]。

method.name: get_fields
method.description:
Returns every field of this component as a [Dictionary] of name to value.
以名称到值的 [Dictionary] 形式返回该组件的所有字段。

method.name: get_type_name
method.description:
Returns the name of the component type this accessor refers to.
返回该访问器所指组件类型的名称。

method.name: is_valid
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying entity is alive and still has this component.
若底层实体存活且仍拥有该组件则返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: set_field
method.description:
Writes [param value] into the field [param name] and marks the row changed. No-op if the field does not exist or the entity is dead.
把 [param value] 写入字段 [param name] 并标记该行已变更。若字段不存在或实体已销毁则为空操作。
